## Before review

- [ ] These are finalized portable bundles, each under bundles/<snapshotId>/.
- [ ] The original evidence, guide/schema, and dataset notices are intact.
- [ ] No models, private machine configuration, checkpoints, or raw local logs are included.
- [ ] Existing accepted bundles have not been edited or removed.
- [ ] I ran the documented validation command, or explained why it was unavailable.

Maintainers: inspect configuration/scoring compatibility, coverage, source notices, and the generated preview before merging. Passing validation establishes structural consistency, not independent reproduction. Review changes to tooling, workflows, and tool pins explicitly.
